items.title: ‘No present or ongoing system of Devadasi dedication’: Karnataka tells SC
items.summary: The Karnataka government, on Thursday, October 1, told the Supreme Court that the practice of dedicating women or girls as Devadasis is not currently prevalent in any of the 15 districts where it was historically reported, following a district-level verification exercise by state authorities. A bench of Justices Augustine George Masih and R Mahadevan took note of the state’s affidavit and directed Karnataka to provide further details on rehabilitation and awareness measures for former Devadasis. The court listed the matter for the next hearing after four weeks. items.title: Jr NTR, Janhvi Kapoor condemn vulgar AI video of Chuttamalle song, vow legal action
items.summary: After a sexually explicit, AI-generated video of the popular Telugu song “Chuttamalle” from Devara: Part 1 surfaced on the internet, actors Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor came out in condemnation, calling it “disgusting” and “disturbing”. Released in September 2024, the film stars Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor in lead roles. “Chuttamalle”, a romantic number composed by Anirudh Ravichander and sung by Shilpa Rao, became popular when it was released. The new AI video manipulates Janhvi’s appearance to make it sexually explicit and vulgar, raising alarm about the misuse of AI to objectify women. “In a land that worships women as mothers and goddesses, where "Matrudevo Bhava" is not just a phrase but a part of our culture, some people have fallen so low that they are using AI to disrespect a woman in the most degrading way possible. Using AI to create something this vile is shameful beyond words,” Jr NTR wrote on social media platform X.
